The value of K_c is independent of the initial concentrations of the reactants and[scan obscured] products but changes only with change in temperature. Remember that the[scan obscured] concentrations of reactants and the products appearing in equilibrium constant[scan obscured] expression (Eq.7.2) are the equilibrium concentrations.

paras.en: Here it should be mentioned that how to recognize that equilibrium has[scan obscured] been reached. For this purpose the concentration of any of the reactant or[scan obscured] product species is monitored, at different time intervals, by analysing them using[scan obscured] any suitable physical or chemical method of analysis. When the concentration of[scan obscured] the chosen species becomes constant, after the elapsed interval, it is an indication of[scan obscured] the fact that the equilibrium state has been reached.
